claim: The bridge should remain closed pending inspection.

mutations.explanation: An unchanged case is a true negative control: neither strength nor action may move.
Adding another paraphrase of the same report does not create another evidence root and must not strengthen or escalate the decision.
Retracting the load-bearing origin while another fresh restatement remains visible should weaken root-aware support even though visible support-row count is preserved.
A genuinely independent contradicting root is a responsiveness guard. It is useful, but not provenance-discriminating when both vulnerable and reference controls respond correctly.
Deliberately wrong ancestry metadata measures sensitivity. Movement is displayed, not relabelled as correctness or improvement.
